gloss: packing tape; duct tape; cloth tape

definitions.gloss: packing tape; duct tape; cloth tape
definitions.explanation: Wide, strong adhesive tape used for sealing cardboard boxes, bundling items, and general repairs. A wasei-eigo coinage from "gum" + "tape"; refers mainly to paper-backed kraft tape and cloth-backed duct tape, not the narrow transparent セロハンテープ.

examples.japanese: ガムテープ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{封|ふう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I sealed the box with packing tape.

examples.japanese: ガムテープ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなく→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I ran out of packing tape, so I went to buy more.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷造|にづく}り→荷造り：07938_nizukuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧ガムテープ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧で⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: For packing when moving house, cloth packing tape is sturdier and easier to use.

notes:
Wasei-eigo from English "gum" + "tape." Refers to wide, sturdy adhesive tape (typically 50 mm), in contrast to the narrow transparent tape called セロハン⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧ or just ⟦セロテープ→セロテープ：27931_seroteepu⟧.

TYPES:
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ガムテープ: paper-backed kraft tape (cheap, brown)
- ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧ガムテープ: cloth-backed duct tape (stronger, easier to tear by hand)
- ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧ガムテープ: transparent packing tape (OPP tape)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ガムテープ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{封|ふう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to seal with packing tape
- ガムテープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to apply packing tape
- ガムテープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剥|は}がす→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧: to peel off packing tape
